note: Create a Character System 3.14.3: Young Sephiroth's hair, coat, collar and wing swing with KawaiiPhysics, a node a strand, strip, collar piece and feather, each with settings a little its own, so they swing apart. His model (YoungSephiroth_P) has no BNM; it keeps its KDI (the wing's KineDriver), and each chain swings about the pose the KDI gives it. 3.14.3: the coat kept out of his legs (leg colliders the size of his legs, rounder coat bones, a wider swing), every chain calmer when he runs. Needs the game mod 3.14.3. Settings: the README's KawaiiPhysics part. (Create a Character System 3.14.5: his KineDriver (PC0010_13_KDI) is taken off his model as it loads: it wrote his wing bones again after KawaiiPhysics, a third of the bones the nodes moved.) 3.17.0 (Kawaii Dynamic Motions' sync bones): the coats' and mantles' chains follow the knees (KawaiiPhysics' SyncBone: the chains in front of a leg when its knee comes forward and up, the ones behind it when it goes back, the side ones when it goes out), and the ones that reach below the knees have the feet as colliders, so a heel kicking back in a run or a kick no longer goes through the cloth as often. Needs the game mod 3.17.0 for the sync bones (an older one reads the feet and leaves the sync bones out).
